page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage or GPU accelerators are bundled with this instance type, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates moderate single-core performance, with a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1876.59 and a Passmark CPU encryption test score of 3632.98, both falling into the average category. However, multi-core and memory-intensive operations show limitations. The stress-ng multi-core CPU performance is 3865.79, and the Passmark CPU score is 5890.72, both classified as weak. Memory bandwidth tests show a weak read-only large block rate of 31.76 GB/sec, though the write large block rate of 25.49 GB/sec remains average.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is designed for compute-bound tasks that do not require massive memory footprints. It achieves average throughput in static web serving at 6.28 GB/sec and handles small-scale LLM inference at 107.71 tokens/sec for text generation. It is suitable for web serving, lightweight single-threaded processing, and basic computational tasks, though it faces performance trade-offs in multi-threaded decompression and high-throughput database operations.
